name: AZSFWC L. Gary Stinson Grant Fund
summary: Quarterly grants from Arizona's Conserving Wildlife licence-plate fund for Arizona-based 501(c)(3) organisations. Pays hard costs of wildlife habitat enhancement, plus conservation education and hunter and angler recruitment; research and environmental assessments are excluded.
reporting: Grantees file progress and final reports with a narrative, budget report, receipts and photos, within 90 days of project completion, and must credit AZSFWC.

calls.label: Quarterly cycles (deadlines 1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul, 1 Oct)
calls.recurring: Application deadlines on January 1, April 1, July 1 and October 1 each year.

status.quote: All grants are considered on a quarterly cycle.

recurring.quote: 1st Quarter Cycle: Application deadline - January 1st Funding decisions by Feb 28 2nd Quarter Cycle: Application deadline - April 1st Funding decision by May 31st 3rd Quarter Cycle: Application deadline - July 1st Funding decisions by August 30th 4th Quarter Cycle: Application deadline - October 1st

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must provide a tax ID number proving the organization is a 501(c)(3) in existence for at least 2 years

geography.quote: indicate the physical presence of a chapter or other unit in Arizona

access.quote: Applications for project funding will be submitted using our online submission form

window.quote: All grants are considered on a quarterly cycle.

reporting.quote: Approved applications require a report filed within 90 days following the project completion
